about: Emivita's screens by purpose: what each one is for, where SPEC specifies it, its status, and what it overlaps with. A reference for SPEC, in the format of Factotum's purpose map (screens by what they do, not by where they sit in the navigation). Drafted 2026-10-13; the purposes were settled with the owner on 2026-10-20 (§7 R102): five purposes, and Settings and the first-launch notice outside them. Rendered by tools/purpose_map.py, which also checks that every screen the code can show has a place here.

purposes.name: Taking today's doses
purposes.job: see what is due, be told when, and answer it: taken, skipped, snoozed, or an extra dose; and when not to be told (weekend mode)

purposes.name: The cabinet, and me
purposes.job: what I take, in what form, on which schedule, and how much is left before it runs out or expires; and what a stranger or a doctor needs to know about me, reachable at once

purposes.name: Looking back
purposes.job: the record of what was taken and missed, corrected when it is wrong, and handed to a doctor

purposes.name: Relying on it
purposes.job: reminders that ring on time and a record that survives: the grants and channels without which a reminder is late or silent, the signs when one was held back, backups, recovery, the lock

purposes.name: Making it mine
purposes.job: how the app looks and reads: palette, Today's layout, language, time format

not_purposes.name: Getting around
not_purposes.job: navigation, not a purpose; its screen is still built for density and the fewest taps, where medTimer's is not

screens.name: Log a dose (as needed, an extra one, or a one-off of a medicine not on the list)
Medicines list, its menu (pause all) and a card's swipe to delete
Add or edit a reminder (fixed times, interval, window, cycle, follow-up, taper)
Export history (CSV, PDF): range and medicines
Permission setup (first launch) and the missing-permissions card
screens.status: shipped; open: say what is missing and open Notifications & alerts, not grant in place (§7 R102)

screens.name: 'A reminder did not fire' card
screens.status: shipped; open: say what is missing and open Notifications & alerts, not grant in place (§7 R102)

screens.name: Database set aside (unreadable, or its key lost)
Privacy & security (app lock, hidden names, screenshot block)
Appearance (palette, Today layout, language, time format)
Settings
screens.status: shipped; open: density and the fewest taps (the owner, §7 R102)

overlap_groups.why: three ways to the same grants: the Settings screen, the first-launch sheet with its Today card, and the card after a reminder was held back; the owner (2026-10-20): Notifications & alerts is the one place that grants, and the first-launch sheet and both cards say what is missing and open it
both write a dose event; one creates it, the other corrects it
both take data off the phone: the backup to restore it, the export to read it

owner_answers: 2026-10-13: add the purpose map as a reference for the SPEC (this draft; the purposes are the owner's to settle).

2026-10-20: five purposes, not seven: Medical ID joins the cabinet (P2, 'The cabinet, and me'), and making it ring joins keeping the data safe (P4, 'Relying on it'); Weekend mode belongs to taking doses (P1); grants have one home, Notifications & alerts, which the sheet and the cards open; Settings is navigation, not a purpose, but its screen is still built for density and the fewest taps, where medTimer's is not. The purpose names and the disclaimer's place as a one-time notice are proposals the owner has not yet confirmed.
